<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-param "<!ENTITY ent-val 'Parameter Expanded'>">
  %ent-param;
  <!ENTITY ent-general "General Entity &ent-val;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing special symbols <>&'" and -- inside -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tag>&ent-general;</tag> and unparsed &logo;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent-general;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Second &e1;">
  <?xml-pi target="data" data="value='test'"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Another header comment -->
  <?target-pi processing instruction data?>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      <item>Nested CDATA with entities &e2;</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (doc)*>
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_dtd "<!ENTITY internal 'Local DTD Entity'>">
  %local_dtd;
  <!ENTITY combined "&internal; and more">
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:m="http://example.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archival root comment -->
  <m:meta>
    <?meta-action type="index"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw archive metadata block: &combined;
    ]]>
  </m:meta>
  <doc>&combined;</doc>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-a "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY ent-b "&ent-a; Beta">
  <!ENTITY ent-c "&ent-b; Gamma">
  <?db-control mode="read-write"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:query="http://example.org/db/query">
  <!-- Comment explaining query context -->
  <query:select query:id="q1">
    <?query-hint use-index="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      SELECT * FROM table WHERE val = '&ent-c;';
    ]]>
  </query:select>
  <record>&ent-c;</record>
</database>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref1 "Reference One">
  <!ENTITY ref2 "&ref1; and Two">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc-pdf SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:sec="http://example.org/doc/sec">
  <!-- Section comment with markup simulation -->
  <sec:section sec:level="1">
    <?sec-cmd execute?>
    <![CDATA[
      Section CDATA payload: &ref2; and binary ref &doc-pdf;
    ]]>
  </sec:section>
  <section>&ref2;</section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY book-title "Advanced XML Processing">
  <!ENTITY book-desc "A guide to &book-title; parsing">
  <!NOTATION epub SYSTEM "application/epub+zip">
  <!ENTITY book-file SYSTEM "book.epub" NDATA epub>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="print.css" type="text/css"?>
<library xmlns="http://example.org/lib" xmlns:cat="http://example.org/lib/cat">
  <!-- Library catalogue comment block -->
  <cat:book cat:isbn="12345">
    <?cat-action type="import"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Library CDATA content: &book-desc; with file &book-file;
    ]]>
  </cat:book>
  <book>&book-desc;</book>
</library>
```

<!DOCTYPE feed [

]>

    <?atom-process step="validate"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Feed CDATA section with description: &feed-desc;
    ]]>
  </atom:entry>
  <entry>&feed-desc;</entry>
</feed>
